# Go modules in this repository that the vulnerability scan does not scan, read by vulnscan
# (tools/cmd/vulnscan). vulnscan scans the root module, as committed (the floor) and with every
# dependency at its newest version (the ceiling), and the tools module. Every other directory with
# a go.mod that git tracks, outside testdata directories, must be listed here with the reason it
# is not scanned: only a test-only module that never ships may be left out.
#
# One module per line: its directory relative to the repository root, then the reason, separated
# by spaces. vulnscan fails on an entry whose directory has no go.mod that git tracks. Blank lines
# and lines that start with # are ignored.

consumer test-only and never ships; its module graph is the SDK's, which the floor scan covers
